comment: * Callback interface for responding to changing state of the selected page.

methods.name: public void onPageScrolled(int position, float positionOffset, @Px int positionOffsetPixels)
methods.comment:
* This method will be invoked when the current page is scrolled, either as part
         * of a programmatically initiated smooth scroll or a user initiated touch scroll.
         *
         * @param position Position index of the first page currently being displayed.
         *                 Page position+1 will be visible if positionOffset is nonzero.
         * @param positionOffset Value from [0, 1) indicating the offset from the page at position.
         * @param positionOffsetPixels Value in pixels indicating the offset from position.

methods.name: public void onPageSelected(int position)
methods.comment:
* This method will be invoked when a new page becomes selected. Animation is not
         * necessarily complete.
         *
         * @param position Position index of the new selected page.

methods.name: public void onPageScrollStateChanged(@ScrollState int state)
methods.comment:
* Called when the scroll state changes. Useful for discovering when the user begins
         * dragging, when a fake drag is started, when the pager is automatically settling to the
         * current page, or when it is fully stopped/idle. {@code state} can be one of {@link
         * #SCROLL_STATE_IDLE}, {@link #SCROLL_STATE_DRAGGING} or {@link #SCROLL_STATE_SETTLING}.

methodNames: public void onPageScrolled(int position, float positionOffset, @Px int positionOffsetPixels)
